assertions.name: jones_polynomials_take_the_classical_value_at_q_1
assertions.source: classical evaluation of the Jones polynomial at q = 1; independent of the Taylor extraction the verdict uses. Hopf link H+: -2 vs -2; Trefoil 3_1 (right-handed): 1 vs 1; Trefoil 3_1 (left-handed): 1 vs 1; Figure-eight 4_1: 1 vs 1; Cinquefoil T(2,5): 1 vs 1; Unknot (sanity): 1 vs 1

assertions.name: required_cubic_coefficient_matches_the_hand_derivation
assertions.unit: h³ coefficient of ℏ_q³ at q = 1 + h
assertions.source: docstring derivation: ℏ_q³ = (q−1)³/q³ = h³·(1 − 3h + …), so the h³ coefficient is 1. Code route: sympy.series of ((q−1)/q)³ under q → 1 + h. Every ✓/✗ in the table is a comparison against this number.

description: Concrete Hyp-C test for rung-2 lift. Computes Jones polynomial Taylor coefficient at (q-1)^3 for 4 natural knots (Hopf, trefoil 3_1, figure-eight 4_1, cinquefoil T(2,5)). Hyp-C is satisfied iff cubic Taylor coefficient = 1. Reports CONFIRMED or REFUTED per knot.

data.combined_status: All three rung-2 lift hypotheses now REFUTED in literal form: Hyp-A (Markov-trace-at-identity, PR #1801), Hyp-B (Wenzl p_3, this PR), Hyp-C (Jones-cubic over unknot, this probe). The categorical source of rung 2 = ℏ_q³/[2]_q remains OPEN; future work needs more exotic candidates (higher-genus knots, convention-shifted Kauffman brackets, or alternative quantum-group constructions).

caveats: Hyp-C is REFUTED by this probe, not confirmed: none of the 5 non-unknot candidates has cubic Taylor coefficient 1. The prose says 'all 4 natural-knot candidates' while the table carries 5 non-unknot rows (both trefoil chiralities); the refutation covers all of them.
